project.name: TruckNet
project.description: A real-time interpersonal communication system for truck drivers enabling geolocation-based discovery, voice/video calling, voice and text messaging, emergency SOS alerts with Kafka-powered fan-out, friend management, driver profiles with avatars, and a fleet admin panel for monitoring drivers, SOS alerts, call history, and conversations.

typography.font-body: Instrument Sans (labels, body text, UI copy)
typography.font-mono: JetBrains Mono (tags, timestamps, status badges, eyebrows)

animations.animate-live-pulse: sage green dot for online status
animations.animate-sos-beat: terra red beat for active SOS alerts
animations.animate-ring-expand / -delay-1 / -delay-: 3-ring concentric expansion for voice call rooms (0 / 0.9s / 1.8s delay)

backend: LiveKit Server SDK (room management + JWT tokens)
KafkaJS v2 (Kafka producer in API routes)
workers: stress-signal-consumer.ts — KafkaJS consumer, fans out SOS alerts to nearby drivers via Ably

UserRegisterSchema.zod: z.object({ name: z.string().min(2), email: z.string().email(), password: z.string().min(8), role: z.enum(['driver','admin']).default('driver'), adminInviteCode: z.string().optional() })
UserRegisterSchema.note: role defaults to 'driver'. adminInviteCode is validated server-side against ADMIN_INVITE_CODE env var when role='admin'.

VoiceMessageSchema.zod: z.object({ receiverId: z.string().uuid(), audioUrl: z.string().url(), durationSeconds: z.number().max(60) })
VoiceMessageSchema.note: API route also accepts { tag, audioUrl, durationSeconds } and resolves tag to UUID before validation

TagInputSchema.note: Validates driver tag format e.g. john#1234. Used in user lookup and voice message send.

EnvSchema.zod: z.object({ DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL, SOCKET_PORT, ABLY_API_KEY, LIVEKIT_URL, LIVEKIT_API_KEY, LIVEKIT_API_SECRET, KAFKA_BROKERS, KAFKA_ENABLED, ADMIN_INVITE_CODE })

roles.name: driver
roles.permissions: Full access to all driver features: dashboard, map, messages, friends, profile, stress signals, voice/video calls

roles.name: admin
roles.permissions: Full access to fleet admin panel: driver monitoring, SOS management, conversation monitoring, call history, fleet map. Admin accounts require an ADMIN_INVITE_CODE at registration.
roles.api_guard: requireAdminSession() — throws 401/403 on any non-admin session

authentication.registration: POST /api/auth/register — hashes password with bcrypt, auto-assigns unique tag (name#XXXX), supports role='driver'|'admin'. Admin registration requires matching ADMIN_INVITE_CODE env var.
authentication.login_redirect: Middleware reads session.user.role and redirects: admin → /admin, driver → /dashboard
authentication.ably_token: GET /api/auth/ably-token — issues signed Ably TokenRequest; client never receives raw API key

user_profile.avatar_upload: POST /api/profile/upload-avatar — multipart, stores file, updates profileImageUrl
user_profile.tag_lookup: GET /api/users/by-tag?tag=name%231234 — resolves tag to user UUID

nearby_drivers.http_source: GET /api/drivers/nearby — enriched with name, profileImageUrl, distanceKm
nearby_drivers.location_persist: POST /api/drivers/location — upserts to driver_locations table + publishes nearby_driver_update via Ably

features: Nearby driver markers (grey dot or avatar circle, orange when selected)
Click marker — popup with driver name, distance, Send Voice Message button
Selected driver overlay card with Send Voice Message button
?focus=<userId> query param — auto-selects and pans to a specific driver (used by friends location button)

voice_messaging.upload: POST /api/upload/audio — multipart upload, returns absolute audioUrl
voice_messaging.send: POST /api/voice-messages — accepts { receiverId, audioUrl, durationSeconds } or { tag, audioUrl, durationSeconds }
voice_messaging.inbox: GET /api/voice-messages — returns received messages with sender info

text_messaging.conversations: GET /api/text-messages/conversations — returns unique conversation partners ordered by most recent message. Used by FriendsSidebar and AdminConversationList.

calls.description: Real-time 1-on-1 voice and video calling powered by LiveKit SFU
calls.initiate: POST /api/calls/initiate — verifies friendship, auto-expires stale ongoing records via LiveKit room participant check, creates LiveKit room, returns { roomName, token, liveKitUrl }
calls.token: GET /api/calls/[roomName] — issues a LiveKit JWT for an existing room
calls.end: DELETE /api/calls/[roomName] — marks call completed, notifies other participant via Ably call_ended
calls.decline: POST /api/calls/[roomName]/decline — marks call declined, notifies caller via Ably call_declined
calls.incoming_ui: IncomingCallModal — full-screen overlay triggered by call_incoming Ably event
calls.active_badge: ActiveCallBadge — floating badge shown when user navigates away from call screen
calls.stale_call_cleanup: On every POST /api/calls/initiate: caller's own ongoing records are unconditionally expired; callee's records are checked against LiveKit for live participants before 409

real_time_events.call_incoming: Sent to callee with roomName, callerName, callerAvatar, pre-generated calleeToken
real_time_events.call_declined: Sent to caller when callee declines
real_time_events.call_ended: Sent to the other participant when one side ends the call
real_time_events.call_missed: Sent to callee if caller ends before callee answers

stress_signal.description: Emergency SOS alert broadcast to all online drivers via Kafka + Ably fan-out
stress_signal.send: POST /api/stress-signals — inserts to DB, produces Kafka message (when KAFKA_ENABLED=true)
stress_signal.worker: workers/stress-signal-consumer.ts — validates payload, queries driver locations, haversine-filters to ≤50 km, fan-out via Ably to each nearby driver's private channel + broadcast on stress:alerts
stress_signal.notification_ui: SosAlertListener component (mounted in protected layout) — shows Sonner toast + native browser Notification API push on stress_signal_alert event; suppressed for the sender

friend_requests.description: Send, accept, reject, and list friend connections between drivers
friend_requests.list: GET /api/friends/list — returns accepted friends and pending incoming requests
friend_requests.location: GET /api/friends/[id]/location — returns friend's last known GPS coordinates and timestamp (403 if not friends)
friend_card_actions: View location (inline expand + View on Map link)
real_time_notify: Ably event friend_request_received to receiver on send
Ably event friend_request_accepted to original sender on accept

admin_panel.description: Fleet management panel accessible only to admin-role users. Secured by requireAdminSession() on all API routes and middleware redirect guard on all /admin pages.
admin_panel.layout: AdminSidebar (56px logo + nav) + AdminHeader (14px title + user info) + page content area on bg-base

components: FleetMap (Leaflet live driver positions, polled every 20s from /api/admin/drivers/live)
DriverTable (search, online/offline filter, paginated, ghost action buttons for voice/video/message/map)
SosAlertCard list (active/resolved filter, resolve button, pagination)

/admin/messages.description: Conversation monitoring — admin can read all conversations and compose messages

/admin/messages/[driverId].description: Direct link to a specific driver conversation thread

/admin/calls.description: Call history table with type/status filters and pagination

listeners.EXTERNAL: localhost:9092 — host machine access (local npm run dev)

topics.trucknet.stress-signals: 3 partitions, replicationFactor 1, 7-day retention. Keyed by signal ID.
topics.trucknet.stress-signals.dlq: 1 partition, replicationFactor 1, 30-day retention. Receives messages that fail processing.

kafka_architecture.producer: lib/kafka.ts — getProducer() singleton, idempotent, lazy connect. Skipped when KAFKA_ENABLED=false (local dev without broker).
kafka_architecture.consumer: workers/stress-signal-consumer.ts — consumer group stress-worker. Payload validated with Zod. Parse errors → DLQ (no re-throw). Delivery errors → DLQ + re-throw for KafkaJS retry. Graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT shutdown.

env_vars.KAFKA_BROKERS: Comma-separated broker list. localhost:9092 for local dev, kafka:29092 inside Docker.
env_vars.KAFKA_ENABLED: true|false. Set false in local dev to skip produce entirely. Set true in Docker.

real_time_architecture.auth_strategy: Ably Token Auth — clients fetch signed TokenRequest from GET /api/auth/ably-token

features: One Ably.Realtime instance per component (singleton pattern via useRef)
Re-subscribes automatically on every Ably reconnection
emit() is a no-op — all client→server data travels over REST
SocketProvider is a passthrough wrapper kept for API compatibility

server_events.nearby_driver_update: NearbyDriverEntry[] — userId, latitude, longitude, updatedAt, name, profileImageUrl, distanceKm
server_events.voice_message_received: VoiceMessageAlert — id, senderId, senderName, audioUrl, durationSeconds, createdAt
server_events.text_message_received: TextMessageAlert — id, senderId, senderName, content, createdAt
server_events.stress_signal_alert: StressSignalAlert — id, userId, senderName, latitude, longitude, createdAt
server_events.sos_resolved: { signalId } — sent to sender when an admin resolves their SOS alert
server_events.call_incoming: CallIncomingAlert — roomName, type, callerName, callerAvatar, callerUserId, liveKitUrl, calleeToken

public: /login — warm maritime sign-in card with role-based redirect note
/register — warm maritime card with driver/admin role selector and honey-styled admin invite code field
protected_driver: /dashboard — location broadcast, nearby drivers list, real-time alerts
/map — Leaflet interactive map; ?focus=<userId> auto-selects a specific driver
/messages — FriendsSidebar conversation list + ChatPanel (text + voice messages)
/friends — friend list with call/message/location actions; pending requests
/profile — view/edit name, upload avatar, view tag
/stress — send SOS signal, view and resolve active signals
protected_admin: /admin/drivers — DriverTable with search, status filter, pagination, action buttons
/admin/sos — SOS alerts list with active/resolved filter, resolve action, pagination
/admin/messages/[driverId] — Direct conversation thread with a specific driver
/admin/calls — CallHistoryTable with type/status filters and pagination

call_history.caller_id: uuid fk users.id (set null on delete)
call_history.callee_id: uuid fk users.id (set null on delete)
call_history.status: enum(ongoing, completed, missed, declined) default ongoing

security_requirements: All driver API routes protected by requireAuth() — returns 401 if unauthenticated
All admin API routes protected by requireAdminSession() — returns 401/403 for non-admin sessions
All API inputs validated with Zod before processing
Environment variables validated at startup via EnvSchema
Ably Token Auth — clients never receive the raw Ably API key
LiveKit JWT tokens scoped to a single room with 8-hour TTL
Friend-only call restriction — POST /api/calls/initiate verifies accepted friendship
Friend-only location restriction — GET /api/friends/[id]/location returns 403 if not friends
Admin invite code required for admin registration — validated against ADMIN_INVITE_CODE env var

non_functional_requirements.kafka_sos_fan_out: Decoupled from API response — produce is fire-and-forget, consumer handles delivery
non_functional_requirements.kafka_consumer_scaling: Horizontal scaling with --scale stress-worker=N (all instances share stress-worker consumer group)
